name: Anonymization
description: Remove or generalize identifiers (k-anonymity, masking, pseudonymization) before data is used or shared.

name: Differential Privacy
description: Add calibrated noise to outputs so no single individual's presence can be inferred.

name: Cryptography
description: Encryption, secure multi-party computation (MPC) and homomorphic encryption to protect data in storage, transit and use.

name: Law & Policy
description: Legal and contractual controls: regulatory compliance, data processing agreements, access policies.

name: Zero-Knowledge Proofs
description: Prove a statement about data is true without revealing the data itself.

name: Federated Learning
description: Train a model where the data lives; only model updates leave each site.
